recipe.name: JB's Chicken Chasseur
recipe.description: Recipe video above. Chicken Chasseur (chasseur is French for “hunter”) is a classic French dish made with pieces of chicken cooked in a rich mushroom and tomato sauce with a gentle touch of brandy, finished with fresh tarragon.
recipeIngredient: 4  chicken thighs, bone-in, skin on ((~250g/8oz each) (Note 1))
Creamy mashed potato ((or rice or small pasta))

itemListElement.text: Season the chicken - Pat the chicken dry thoroughly with paper towels.
itemListElement.name: Season the chicken - Pat the chicken dry thoroughly with paper towels.

itemListElement.text: Brown the Chicken - Heat vegetable oil in a large (30cm/12") skillet (with lid) over medium-high heat.
itemListElement.name: Brown the Chicken - Heat vegetable oil in a large (30cm/12") skillet (with lid) over medium-high heat.

itemListElement.text: Tomato and stock -  Stir in the tomato paste, cook for 1 minute. Then add the stock, salt, and pepper.
